class.name: HTMLLayout
class.brief_description: Parses and lays out HTML for drawing on a [CanvasItem].
class.description: Use [method parse] to load an HTML document or fragment and [method layout] to set its viewport size. Call [method draw] from the target [CanvasItem]'s [method CanvasItem._draw] callback. Call [method CanvasItem.queue_redraw] after changing the document, viewport size, or drawing position. Supports block and inline layout, lists, tables, text, backgrounds, and local images. Borders support [code]solid[/code], [code]dashed[/code], [code]dotted[/code], and [code]double[/code], with separate styles, widths, and colors per side. [code]border-radius[/code] rounds backgrounds, borders, and images, and clips overflowing children when [code]overflow: hidden[/code] is set. Backgrounds support [code]linear-gradient()[/code], [code]radial-gradient()[/code], and [code]conic-gradient()[/code] with sRGB color interpolation. Text uses the project theme's default font or Godot's fallback font. Run the renderer on the main thread. [code]box-shadow[/code] supports offsets, blur, spread, and comma-separated layers. Use [code]inset[/code] for an inner shadow. Shadows follow [code]border-radius[/code] and leave layout and scroll ranges unaffected. [code]text-shadow[/code] supports horizontal and vertical offsets, optional blur and color, and comma-separated layers. The first layer is drawn closest to the text. Use [code]none[/code] to clear inherited text shadows. CSS [code]transform[/code] supports 2D translation, rotation, and scaling. [code]transform-origin[/code] sets their pivot in the element's border box. Drawing, element and link hit tests, and text selection follow the transformed boxes.

method.name: adopt_node
method.description: Moves [param element] and its descendants to this layout and returns the same handle. Existing descendant handles also follow the move. The subtree is detached and can be inserted under a parent in this layout. Adopting within the same layout detaches the subtree. Form controls keep their current values, modified flags, checked state, and selection. The source ends focus and input method composition for the moved subtree and discards its pending input commit signals. Moving a connected subtree schedules reflow in the source. The target lays it out when it is inserted into the target document tree. Returns [code]null[/code] if the handle is invalid, the element is the source document root, or the target has no successful [method parse].

method.name: clear
method.description: Releases the document, layout, and drawing resources, and clears the last error.

method.name: create_document_fragment
method.description: Creates an empty fragment owned by this layout. Returns [code]null[/code] if the layout has no successful [method parse].

method.name: create_element
method.description: Creates an element owned by this layout after a successful [method parse]. Pass a tag name such as [code]li[/code] or [code]quest-card[/code]. ASCII letters in the name are lowercased. Returns [code]null[/code] if the name is invalid or there is no parsed document. The new element has no parent. Set its attributes and content, then insert it using [method HTMLElement.append_child] on a parent from the same layout. Unattached elements are outside document queries and have no layout rectangles. On an empty document, the first creation also makes [code]html[/code], [code]head[/code], and [code]body[/code] available to queries.

method.name: draw
method.description: Draws the current layout during [method CanvasItem._draw]. Both the top-left drawing position and the optional axis-aligned clip rectangle are in the canvas item's local coordinates. The default clip applies only the document's clipping rules. Before a successful layout, this method draws nothing.

method.name: get_anchor_rect
method.description: Returns the visual bounds of the first laid-out element with the given case-sensitive HTML [code]id[/code], in document coordinates. Pass the ID without [code]#[/code]. Returns an empty rectangle if the element has no layout or the ID is absent.

method.name: get_content_size
method.description: Returns the content size in pixels from the most recent successful layout of the current document, including scrollable overflow from CSS transforms. Returns [constant Vector2i.ZERO] before layout and for an empty document.

method.name: get_element_at
method.description: Returns the frontmost element at the given document pixel position, accounting for overflow clipping. Returns [code]null[/code] when there is no hit or no layout.

method.name: get_element_by_id
method.description: Returns the first element with the given case-sensitive HTML ID, including hidden elements. Pass the ID without [code]#[/code]. Returns [code]null[/code] if the ID is absent.

method.name: get_link_at
method.description: Returns the original [code]href[/code] of the link at a point in document coordinates, or an empty string. Subtract the drawing position from the canvas-local point and apply any caller-supplied clip before querying. The caller handles navigation.

method.name: get_css_diagnostics
method.description: Returns a copy of the CSS diagnostics collected during the latest style calculation. Each dictionary contains [code]kind[/code], [code]property[/code], [code]value[/code], [code]source[/code], and [code]path[/code]. [code]kind[/code] is [code]unknown_property[/code], [code]unsupported_value[/code], or [code]not_rendered[/code]. [code]source[/code] is [code]inline_style[/code], [code]style_element[/code], [code]stylesheet[/code], or [code]local_stylesheet[/code]. Only local stylesheets include a resource [code]path[/code].

method.name: get_render_error
method.description: Returns the diagnostic message from the last failed parse or layout. A successful parse or layout clears the message.

method.name: get_accessible_text
method.description: Returns text in document order for assistive technologies. CSS alternatives specified after the slash in [code]content[/code] replace the spoken content, including explicit empty alternatives. Image [code]alt[/code] attributes supply text when no CSS alternative applies. Returns an empty string before layout.

method.name: get_plain_text
method.description: Returns the laid-out text in document order, using the original characters for the [code]text-transform[/code] CSS property. Block boundaries and explicit line breaks are represented by newlines. Preserved tab characters stay as tabs, and table cells are separated by tabs. Soft wrapping does not add newlines. Returns an empty string before layout.

method.name: get_selection_rects
method.description: Returns axis-aligned bounds in document coordinates for the visible highlights of the character range from [param from] up to [param to]. These bounds account for CSS transforms and overflow clipping. Offsets refer to [method get_plain_text] and are clamped to its length.

method.name: hit_test_text
method.description: Returns the nearest caret offset in [method get_plain_text] for a point in document coordinates. Returns [code]0[/code] when there is no text.

method.name: import_node
method.description: Copies [param element] into this layout as a detached element with a new handle. The source can belong to any layout. See [method HTMLElement.clone_node] for what [param deep] copies and how form controls retain their state. The copy remains valid if the source layout is cleared. Insert the copy under a parent in this layout to lay it out. Relative resource paths resolve from this layout's base directory. On an empty document, the first import also makes [code]html[/code], [code]head[/code], and [code]body[/code] available to queries. Returns [code]null[/code] if the source handle is invalid or this layout has no successful [method parse].

method.name: layout
method.description: Updates media queries and lays out the current document using the viewport width and height in pixels. Returns [constant OK] on success, [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] for nonpositive dimensions, [constant ERR_UNCONFIGURED] before a successful parse, or [constant ERR_INVALID_DATA] if the layout cannot be represented.

method.name: parse
method.description: Replaces the document and resets its layout. An empty string creates an empty document. Styles come from inline attributes, [code]<style>[/code] elements, [code]<link rel="stylesheet">[/code], and the optional stylesheet text. Use [code]@import[/code] to include UTF-8 [code].css[/code] files within the project. Relative URLs in a CSS file are resolved from that file's directory. Relative URLs in HTML and stylesheet text are resolved from [param base_dir]. Paths may use [code]../[/code] within the project or absolute [code]res://[/code] paths. Images can be imported PNG, JPEG, WebP, or SVG textures. Missing or unsupported assets are skipped. Returns [constant OK] on success, [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] for a base directory outside [code]res://[/code], or [constant ERR_PARSE_ERROR] if the document cannot be parsed. The additional [param stylesheet] contributes author rules after the document's stylesheets. The author cascade compares [code]!important[/code], inline style precedence, cascade layer, selector specificity, and source order, in that order. A rule in the additional stylesheet wins by source order when all earlier criteria are equal. In a document without author layers, [code]revert[/code] and [code]revert-layer[/code] restore the pre-author defaults and HTML presentational hints. Invalid literal declarations are ignored. Custom properties and longhand declarations are cascaded before [code]var()[/code] substitution. If substitution makes the winning value invalid, that longhand uses [code]unset[/code]. A shorthand with [code]var()[/code] is resolved once per element and only updates the longhands it wins. CSS-wide keywords produced by substitution are evaluated as usual. On a custom property, the keyword is applied before substituting values that reference that property.

method.name: query_selector
method.description: Returns the first match in document order, or [code]null[/code]. See [method query_selector_all] for selector syntax.

method.name: query_selector_all
method.description: Returns matching elements from the litehtml element tree in document order, with each element included once. Tags, classes, IDs, attributes, combinators, and comma-separated lists are supported. Queries include hidden elements and are available after parsing. Invalid or unsupported selectors report an error and return an empty array.

method.name: get_document_node
method.description: Returns the live document node, or [code]null[/code] before a document exists.

method.name: get_document_element
method.description: Returns the root element of the live document.

method.name: get_head
method.description: Returns the document's head element, if present.

method.name: get_body
method.description: Returns the document's body or frameset element, if present.

method.name: get_title
method.description: Returns the HTML document title with runs of ASCII whitespace collapsed.

method.name: set_title
method.description: Edits the title of this layout's live document.

method.name: get_elements_by_tag_name
method.description: Returns a snapshot of elements with the given tag name in tree order. Pass [code]*[/code] for all elements.

method.name: get_elements_by_class_name
method.description: Returns a snapshot of elements matching all of the whitespace-separated class names.

method.name: get_elements_by_name
method.description: Returns a snapshot of elements whose HTML [code]name[/code] attribute matches exactly.

method.name: create_text_node
method.description: Creates a detached text node in this layout.

method.name: create_comment
method.description: Creates a detached comment in this layout.

method.name: parse_fragment
method.description: Parses a detached fragment in the specified element's context. The default context is [code]body[/code].

method.name: import_fragment
method.description: Deep-copies the source fragment into this layout.

method.name: adopt_fragment
method.description: Transfers an independent fragment and its existing handles into this layout. A fragment owned by a template can be transferred with its template element.

method.name: get_elements_at
method.description: Returns the elements at the given document position in front-to-back hit order, with each element included once.

method.name: create_range
method.description: Creates a live range with both endpoints at the start of the DOM document.

method.name: get_selection
method.description: Returns the live document selection, or [code]null[/code] if the document is unavailable.

method.name: get_computed_style
method.description: Returns a snapshot of serialized computed CSS properties. Lengths that depend on a layout box can retain percentages. See [method HTMLElement.get_bounding_rect] for geometry.

method.name: get_computed_style_property
method.description: Returns a serialized computed value for a connected element, including sampled animation values. Pass [code]::before[/code], [code]::after[/code], [code]::marker[/code], [code]::placeholder[/code], or [code]::selection[/code] to inspect a supported pseudo-element. Returns an empty string if the value is unavailable.

method.name: get_stylesheets
method.description: Returns the author stylesheets in source order. Each dictionary includes [code]id[/code], [code]owner[/code], [code]source[/code], [code]path[/code], and [code]media[/code]. The additional stylesheet is last. IDs apply to the current layout generation.

method.name: get_css_rules
method.description: Returns a serialized snapshot of the top-level rules in the stylesheet identified by [param stylesheet]. Grouped and imported rules retain their place in the list.

method.name: insert_rule
method.description: Inserts one CSS rule at the given zero-based index. The edit applies to this layout. Invalid rules or indices leave the stylesheet as it was.

method.name: delete_rule
method.description: Deletes the top-level rule at the given zero-based index in this layout.

method.name: supports_css
method.description: Tests a CSS property and value, or a [code]@supports[/code] condition when [param value] is empty.

method.name: supports_selector
method.description: Tests whether the selector is accepted by the CSS selector parser.

method.name: matches_media
method.description: Tests the media query against the current CSS viewport and preferences.

method.name: get_animations
method.description: Returns CSS animations, CSS transitions, and scripted animations. Pass an element to restrict the snapshot to that target.

method.name: animate
method.description: Creates a scripted animation on the current layout clock. Keyframe dictionaries contain CSS property values and optional [code]offset[/code] and [code]easing[/code]. Options include [code]duration[/code], [code]delay[/code], [code]iterations[/code], [code]easing[/code], [code]direction[/code], and [code]fill[/code]. Times are in seconds. Returns [code]null[/code] for invalid input or an empty effect.

members.member: Collects CSS declaration diagnostics and outlines affected elements when drawing. Enable this before [method parse] to collect initial results, or call [method layout] after enabling it on an existing document. Disabling it clears the results immediately. See [method get_css_diagnostics].
